description: Variation of condition 2 (Approved plans) of planning permission reference 20/5029/S73 dated 03/12/2025 for "Application pursuant to Section 73 of the Town and Country Planning Act to vary Condition 3 (approved plans) of planning permission 20/2332/CON dated 3rd September 2020 for the erection of a part two, part three storey building with roof terrace to accommodate a visitor centre (Class B1) including exhibition space and flexible ground floor commercial space (Class A3/B1) to accommodate either a café or additional floorspace for visitor centre, with associated earthworks, servicing, cycle parking and landscaping. Amendments are proposed to the site landscaping; internal configuration of spaces; building footprint; set back second storey; building height; location of entrances to building and fenestration. The amendments result in an increase to the building floorspace of 39m2 Gross internal area (GIA) -740m2 to 779m2; and an overall building height increase of 195mm -12,530mm increased to 12,725mm -including lift overrun". Variation to include this permission shall be for a limited period only,expiring on 3rd December 2030 when the development hereby permitted shall be discontinued and the buildings and works carried out under this permission shall be removed and the land reinstated in accordance with the details approved for Claremont Park Improvements -LPA Ref: 19/2291/FUL- or, as subsequently amended
